page.content:
Promoter who turned the WWWF into a national, then global, WWE.

How Vince McMahon connects

  • Topic: WWE — Vince McMahon built WWE from the WWWF.
  • Event: WrestleMania — Vince McMahon gambled the company on the first WrestleMania.
  • Character: Stone Cold Steve Austin — Stone Cold's weekly war with boss Vince McMahon drove Attitude Era television.
  • Concept: Attitude Era — Vince McMahon booked the Attitude Era that saved the ratings war.

What is Vince McMahon?

Vince McMahon bought the World Wide Wrestling Federation from his father and expanded it through national cable, WrestleMania, the Attitude Era, and the publicly traded WWE that later folded into TKO.

Key threads lead to WWE, WrestleMania, Stone Cold Steve Austin and Attitude Era.
